have hcard : circleSeven.card = 7 := by
    unfold circleSeven
    have hsin : Real.sin (Real.pi / 7) ≠ 0 := by
      have h : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi / 7 := by
        apply lt_of_lt_of_le
        · norm_num
        · have : (7 : ℝ) ≥ 1 := by norm_num
          have h' : Real.pi ≥ 1 := by
            have := Real.pi_gt_31415
            have := Real.pi_lt_31416
            norm_num at *
            linarith
          have h'' : (1 : ℝ) / 7 ≤ Real.pi / 7 := by
            apply (div_le_div_right (show (0 : ℝ) < 7 by norm_num)).mpr
            norm_num at *
            linarith
          have h''' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 7 := by norm_num
          have : (1 : ℝ) / 7 * 7 = 1 := by norm_num
          linarith [h'', h''']
          <;> norm_num
      have h1 : Real.pi / 7 < Real.pi := by
        have h2 : (7 : ℝ) > 1 := by norm_num
        have h3 : Real.pi / 7 < Real.pi := by
          apply (div_lt_iff (show (0 : ℝ) < 7 by norm_num)).mpr
          linarith [Real.pi_pos]
        exact h3
      exact (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h h1).ne'
    have hinjective : Function.Injective
        (fun k : ℕ => !₂[1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * ↑k / 7) +
            1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 7),
          1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * ↑k / 7) +
            1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7)]) := by
      intro k l h
      have hk : k ≤ 6 := by
        have hmem : k ∈ Finset.range 7 := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_range] at *
          exact Finset.mem_range.1 (by
            simp only [Finset.mem_range]
            exact by
              have : circleSeven.card = 7 := by
                unfold circleSeven
                simp [Finset.card_range, Finset.image]
              omega)
        omega
      have hl : l ≤ 6 := by
        have hmem : l ∈ Finset.range 7 := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_range] at *
          exact Finset.mem_range.1 (by
            simp only [Finset.mem_range]
            exact by
              have : circleSeven.card = 7 := by
                unfold circleSeven
                simp [Finset.card_range, Finset.image]
              omega)
        omega
      norm_num at hk hl
      omega
    exact Finset.card_range_injective (Finset.range 7) hinjective
  have hdist : distinctDistances circleSeven = 1 := by
    unfold distinctDistances distanceSet circleSeven
    have eucl_dist_one_of_sq : ∀ {x y : ℝ²}, dist x y ^ 2 = 1 → dist x y = 1 := by
      intro x y h
      nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y), sq_nonneg (dist x y)]
    have hd : dist
        (!₂[1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (0 : ℕ) / 7) +
            1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 7),
          1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (0 : ℕ) / 7) +
            1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7)])
        (!₂[1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℕ) / 7) +
            1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 7),
          1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℕ) / 7) +
            1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7)]) = 1 :=
      eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, mul_div_cancel']
        nlinarith [Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two]
    suffices h :
        circleSeven.offDiag.image (fun (pair : ℝ² × ℝ²) => dist pair.1 pair.2) = {1} by
      simp only [h, Finset.card_singleton]
    refine Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨⟨!₂[1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (0 : ℕ) / 7) +
          1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 7),
        1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (0 : ℕ) / 7) +
          1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7)],
      !₂[1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℕ) / 7) +
          1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.cos (Real.pi / 7),
        1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℕ) / 7) +
          1 / (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi / 7)) * Real.sin (4 * Real.pi / 7)]⟩,
      by simp [Finset.mem_offDiag], hd⟩, fun d hd => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
    simp only [Finset.mem_offDiag, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hab
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, _⟩ := hab
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      first
      | contradiction
      | exact hd
      | exact hd
      | exact hd
      | exact hd
      | exact hd
      | exact hd
  have hmin : minimalDistinctDistances ℝ² 7 = 1 := by
    unfold minimalDistinctDistances
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact Nat.sInf_le ⟨circleSeven, hcard, by exact_mod_cast hdist⟩
    · apply le_csInf
      · exact ⟨_, circleSeven, hcard, rfl⟩
      rintro d ⟨points, hcard', hd⟩
      rw [← show distinctDistances points = d from by exact_mod_cast hd]
      exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ((Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [Finset.offDiag_card, hcard']; norm_num :
          0 < points.offDiag.card)).image _)
  exact ⟨hcard, by rw [hdist, hmin]⟩
